text: What is the purpose of the dog?
sub: Every dog has unique strengths and personality traits. Choosing the role that matters most to you helps us recommend breeds that naturally fit your lifestyle and expectations.

options.label: Family Companion
options.desc: Friendly, affectionate and loving breeds that enjoy spending time with the entire family.

options.label: Home Guardian
options.desc: Confident and loyal breeds that naturally stay alert and protective of their loved ones.

options.label: Exercise & Adventure Partner
options.desc: Energetic breeds that enjoy walks, runs, travel and outdoor activities with you.

options.label: Emotional Support & Comfort
options.desc: Gentle and emotionally connected breeds that bring warmth, companionship and calmness.

options.label: Companion for Seniors
options.desc: Calm, easygoing and loving breeds that are comfortable in peaceful home environments.

options.label: I already love a specific breed.
options.desc: Skip the quiz and jump straight to exploring every breed in our database.

text: What type of home do you live in?
sub: Your living space helps us understand how comfortably different dog breeds can adapt to your daily environment, movement space and lifestyle.

options.label: 1BHK Apartment (under 600 sq ft)
options.desc: Compact and cozy homes that are ideal for smaller companion breeds that enjoy indoor living.

options.label: 2BHK Apartment (600 to 1,000 sq ft)
options.desc: Balanced apartment spaces suitable for many small and medium-sized family-friendly breeds.

options.label: 3BHK / 4BHK Apartment (1,000 to 2,000 sq ft)
options.desc: Spacious apartments that comfortably support active and medium-to-large companion breeds.

options.label: Independent house, no yard
options.desc: Comfortable indoor home environments with larger movement space for a variety of breeds.

options.label: Independent house with yard
options.desc: Excellent setup for energetic and playful breeds that enjoy outdoor activity and open areas.

text: Which city do you live in?
sub: Heat is the single biggest health risk for dogs in India, and humid heat is far harder on them than dry heat. Your city tells us exactly which breeds can cope.

text: How familiar are you with caring for dogs?
sub: Understanding your comfort level with dogs helps us recommend breeds that suit your experience and daily routine.

options.label: First-Time Dog Parent
options.desc: Perfect for discovering friendly and beginner-friendly breeds with easier care routines.

options.label: Some Experience
options.desc: You already understand basic care, companionship and everyday dog routines.

options.label: Experienced Dog Owner
options.desc: Comfortable with training, handling and caring for a wide range of dog personalities.

text: How many hours a day can you dedicate to walks/play?
sub: Every breed has a real daily exercise requirement, not a personality label. The time you actually have tells us which breeds you can keep genuinely satisfied.

options.label: Under 30 minutes
options.desc: Best suited to breeds with light exercise needs and a calm indoor temperament.

options.label: 30 minutes to 1 hour
options.desc: Comfortable for most breeds with moderate daily exercise needs.

options.label: 1 to 2 hours
options.desc: Enough for energetic breeds that need real daily exercise to stay settled.

options.label: 2 hours or more
options.desc: Suited to high-energy breeds that need serious daily exercise, or they become restless or destructive.

text: What kind of activity does your dog get most days?
sub: Time alone doesn't capture everything — an hour of slow walking and an hour of running ask completely different things of a dog's body and temperament.

options.label: Slow, leisurely walks
options.desc: A gentle pace, well suited to calmer breeds or ones with joint sensitivity.

options.label: Brisk walks or active play
options.desc: A steady, purposeful pace with games or yard time mixed in.

options.label: Running, hiking, fetch or dog sports
options.desc: Vigorous, sustained activity — what high-drive working and sporting breeds actually need.

text: What monthly care budget feels comfortable for you?
sub: Different breeds have different grooming, nutrition and healthcare needs. We will suggest breeds that comfortably fit your preferred care style.

options.label: Under Rs.5,000
options.desc: Suitable for many loving and low-maintenance companion breeds.

options.label: Rs.5,000 to Rs.10,000
options.desc: Comfortable for most popular family and companion breeds.

options.label: Rs.10,000 to Rs.20,000
options.desc: Ideal for premium breeds with regular grooming and detailed care.

options.label: Above Rs.20,000
options.desc: Perfect for giant or luxury breeds with premium lifestyle needs.

text: Who lives at home with you?
sub: Your home environment helps us recommend breeds that naturally fit your family structure and lifestyle.

options.label: Young Children
options.desc: Ideal for playful, patient and family-friendly companion breeds.

options.label: Senior Family Members
options.desc: Comfortable with calm and easygoing breeds suited for peaceful homes.

options.label: Both Children & Seniors
options.desc: Best matched with gentle and adaptable breeds that suit all age groups.

options.label: Adults Only
options.desc: Flexible home setup that supports a wide variety of dog personalities.

text: What kind of grooming and shedding level do you prefer?
sub: Different breeds shed differently. Choosing your preference helps us match breeds that fit your comfort and maintenance style.

options.label: Comfortable With Shedding
options.desc: You are comfortable with regular brushing and routine home cleaning.

options.label: Moderate Shedding Preferred
options.desc: Balanced option with manageable grooming and moderate coat maintenance.

options.label: Low Shedding Preferred
options.desc: Great for cleaner indoor spaces and lower grooming maintenance.

text: Do you have a preferred coat or hair length?
sub: Coat length affects appearance, grooming effort and maintenance routines. Choose the style you personally enjoy most.

options.label: Short Coat
options.desc: Easy to maintain with a clean and sleek appearance.

options.label: Medium Coat
options.desc: Balanced appearance with manageable grooming requirements.

options.label: Long Coat
options.desc: Elegant and fluffy appearance with regular grooming routines.

options.label: No Preference
options.desc: Open to all coat types and focused mainly on personality compatibility.

text: When are you planning to bring a dog home?
sub: This is the last one. It tells us whether to introduce you to a breeder now or send you home with reading first — nobody benefits from being rushed.

options.label: Within the next month
options.desc: You are ready now and want to meet available puppies as soon as possible.

options.label: 1-3 months
options.desc: You have decided to go ahead and are working out the timing.

options.label: 3-6 months
options.desc: You are planning ahead and want to be properly prepared first.

options.label: Still researching
options.desc: You are learning about breeds and have not decided anything yet.
